items.title: Microchip Technology (MCHP) Expands Industrial FPGA Features, Is The 28% Undervalued View Enough?
items.summary: Industrial networking and space compute push Microchip Technology into focus Microchip Technology (MCHP) has put its PolarFire FPGA platform back in the spotlight, adding EtherCAT and Time Sensitive Networking features that aim to serve industrial edge and real time applications. Against that product backdrop, Microchip Technology’s share price has eased 6.4% over the past 30 days and 5.7% over 90 days.
